直接输入想说的话；/help 查看命令；Ctrl-C 中断当前回复；Ctrl-D: Just type what you want to say; /help lists commands; Ctrl-C stops the current reply; Ctrl-D or /exit quits.
确认是你和模型之间唯一的关卡。全部放开之后，助手读到的网页或文件里如果藏着恶意的: The permission prompt is the only checkpoint between you and the model. With everything allowed, if a web page or file the assistant reads hides malicious instructions, it could run commands, change your files or send them somewhere without you seeing it. Only turn this on when you trust the task at hand and will keep an eye on it.
